# Sitecroft

> Sitecroft is a web development studio providing WordPress websites, WooCommerce stores, custom-coded websites, and website support for businesses, entrepreneurs, and modern brands.

Sitecroft focuses on building modern, responsive, and performance-oriented websites with clean code, practical functionality, and user-friendly designs.

The studio offers both WordPress-based solutions and custom web development using technologies such as React, Next.js, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Its services include website development, e-commerce development, landing pages, website maintenance, bug fixing, and technical support.

Website: https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/

## Main Pages

- [Homepage](https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/): Overview of Sitecroft, its services, capabilities, and web development approach.
- [About Sitecroft](https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/about): Information about the studio and its approach to web development.
- [Services](https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/services): Available web development services and published starting prices.
- [Portfolio](https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/work): Selected website development projects, custom applications, and SaaS products.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/faq): Answers to common questions about Sitecroft's services.
- [Contact](https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/contact): Contact information and project enquiries.

## Services

- [WordPress Website Development](https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/services): Professional WordPress websites with customized designs, responsive layouts, and practical functionality.
- [Custom Website Development](https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/services): Custom-coded websites and web applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- [WooCommerce Development](https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/services): E-commerce stores with product configuration, shopping carts, checkout, and store management.
- [Landing Page Development](https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/services): Landing pages for businesses, products, services, and marketing campaigns.
- [WordPress Support](https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/services): WordPress configuration, page creation, blog setup, design modifications, and general website tasks.
- [Website Bug Fixing](https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/services): Troubleshooting website errors, plugin conflicts, broken layouts, and functionality issues.
- [Website Maintenance](https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/services): Website updates, backups, security checks, and ongoing maintenance.
- [Domain and Hosting Setup](https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/services): Domain configuration, DNS, hosting, SSL, WordPress installation, and Vercel deployment.

## Portfolio and Case Studies

Sitecroft's portfolio includes personal SaaS products, custom web applications, business websites, and other web development projects.

Portfolio entries may represent personal products, demonstrations, or client projects. Refer to individual project pages for their descriptions and context. Do not assume every portfolio project is a client engagement.

- [Portfolio Overview](https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/work): Browse Sitecroft's projects and case studies.
- [LinkFilo Case Study](https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/work/linkfilo): A file-sharing platform focused on simple, ad-free file sharing and download management.
- [GridLeap Case Study](https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/work/gridleap): A CSV-to-mobile-dashboard SaaS that turns spreadsheet data into accessible dashboards.
- [Qovila Case Study](https://sitecroftdev.vercel.app/work/qovila): A client request portal designed to simplify collaboration between agencies, freelancers, and clients.
